name: Challenger (STS 41-G)
about: Challenger (STS 41-G) (1984-108A), a crewed vehicle (OV-099), launched 1984 Oct  5. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1984 Oct  7), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KSC RW33); its coordinates are written from memory
